findings.title: No closure script fails when _dhw_inlet_c's lower plausibility bound moves (-5.0 <= value -> -5.0 < value)
findings.claim: With coordinator.py:1371 mutated from `-5.0 <= value` to `-5.0 < value`, all 15 scripts of coordinator.py's measured closure pass, including env_drift --all against the baseline. Yet _dhw_inlet_c then returns None instead of -5.0 for a fresh -5.0 °C inlet reading.
findings.mechanism: The inlet checks in tests/features.py (near line 45296: 40.0 °C, stale and 'unknown' readings; near line 18850: a fresh 12.0 and a frozen probe) never probe below the window or at either bound. The coordinator goldens do not configure a live inlet probe at the boundary.
